scope: Read-only deterministic probes of current application modules; no live provider requests or paid AI calls.
warning: All records and AI replies in validation probes are synthetic adversarial fixtures. They demonstrate accepted failure cases, not actual student searches, actual published findings, or measured model error rates.

probes.input: Compare loneliness in adolescents and older adults
probes.expected: Retain both adolescents and older adults and the comparison intent, or request clarification. Never silently remove one requested population.

probes.input: Find studies of social media and mental health, but I do not want systematic reviews

actual.compiledQuery: "social media" AND "mental health" AND "but not" AND ("systematic review" OR "systematic reviews")

probes.expected: Exclude systematic reviews, preserve the two topic concepts, and remove instruction words from the topical query.

source.title: A study
source.abstractText: The study did not establish that vaccination causes autism in children. The observed association was due to selection bias.

submittedReply.message: Vaccination causes autism, this study proves it.

actual.message: Vaccination causes autism, this study proves it.

probes.expected: Do not display a substring that reverses the full sentence's meaning. Preserve complete sentence context, negation, and qualifications. Suppress unsupported research conclusions rather than relying only on an unverified-orientation disclaimer.

source.title: Bibliometric map of air pollution research and childhood asthma publications
source.abstractText: This bibliometric index describes the number of publications on air pollution. Childhood asthma appears in the indexing keywords; no health outcomes were studied.

probes.expected: A keyword label can be literally correct, but should not establish research usefulness. Distinguish bibliometric/background roles from studies of the requested relationship, and evaluate ranking against independent judgments.
